stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及手段]巴塞尔银行监管委员会发布了关于"妥善管理与洗钱和恐怖主义融资相关风险"的指导方针.关于识别和接纳客户,它建议银行:(选择两项.)

options.A: 制定政策和程序,确保对所有客户开展的尽职调查活动完全一致.
options.B: 制定政策和程序,以识别和核实客户、受益所有人以及任何能够代表客户进行交易的个人.
options.C: 制定基于风险程度不同的客户尽职调查政策和程序.
options.D: 即使已建立程序来收集和保存尽职调查信息,也不得向客户提供编号账户.
options.E: 制定相关政策和程序,鼓励在尽职调查信息建立和核实期间处理交易

stem_en: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision published guidelines on the "Sound management of risks related to money laundering and financing of terrorism." With regard to identifying and accepting customers, it recommends that banks: (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Establish policies and procedures to ensure due diligence activities are identical for all customers.
options_en.B: Establish policies and procedures to identify and verify customers, beneficial owners, and any individuals that can transact on behalf of their customers.
options_en.C: Establish policies and procedures for customer due diligence that vary based on risk.
options_en.D: Do not provide numbered accounts to customers, even if procedures are in place to collect and store due diligence information.
options_en.E: Establish policies and procedures that encourage processing transactions while due diligence information is being established and verified.
